debts.title: Legacy FastAPI backend unused by dashboard
debts.description_es: El backend FastAPI completo sigue en el repo pero el dashboard usa supabase-js directo y Edge Functions desde la Fase 8. Su capa de auth no aplica scoping multi-tenant. Candidato a borrado o archivado tras confirmar que ningún servicio (gateway, cron, scraper) lo consume.
debts.description_en: Full FastAPI backend remains in the repo but the dashboard uses supabase-js directly and Edge Functions since Fase 8. Its auth layer lacks multi-tenant scoping. Candidate for deletion or archiving after confirming no service (gateway, cron, scraper) consumes it.
debts.proposed_fix_es: Auditar consumidores → archivar o eliminar backend/ → limpiar docker-compose y ENV asociadas.
debts.proposed_fix_en: Audit consumers → archive or delete backend/ → clean docker-compose and related ENV vars.
